item.title: BYD nears 30,000 sales
item.description: BYD Cars Philippines sold 28,399 vehicles from January to August 2026, up 99 percent from the same period last year.

item.description: Twin brothers Paolo Benjamin and Miguel Benjamin of Filipino indie folk-pop band Ben&Ben have joined Toyota Motor Asia’s Move Your World Beat campaign, bringing Filipino music to a regional lineup of Asian artists. item.title: VinFast offers decade-long EV protection
item.description: VinFast is offering vehicle and battery warranties of up to 10 years in the Philippines as it seeks to address concerns about the long-term cost of electric vehicle ownership.

item.title: Toyota gets Ben&Ben in the mix
item.description: Toyota Motor Asia has tapped Ben&Ben members Paolo Benjamin and Miguel Benjamin to represent the Philippines in a regional music project that turns vehicle sounds into original tracks.

item.title: Tamaraw takes on new roles
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines will display several Tamaraw variants and conversions at four events in Metro Manila and Cebu this week.

item.title: Madring mayhem: F1 drivers expecting crashes, chaos at Spanish GP circuit
item.description: Madrid, Spain (AFP) — Formula One drivers are expecting a weekend of crashes and chaos at the new Circuito de Madring as it hosts the Spanish Grand Prix for the first time.

item.title: Honda hits 10 million
item.description: Honda Philippines Inc. has produced its 10-millionth motorcycle, more than five decades after the company began local manufacturing in Parañaque. item.title: The Bovensiepen Spider Is What a BMW Alpina Z4 Would’ve Been
item.description: From the family that founded the Alpina brand comes a tuned version of the BMW Z4 that gets an extra 47 horsepower and more refined styling.

item.title: China Has Already Exported More Cars Than Last Year
item.description: Growing global sales of EV and PHEV models have pushed China's export numbers to their highs, despite shrinking sales at home.
